workflow.name: Titan improves its own runtime checks and inspection guide
workflow.goal: Use the installed Titan controller and real Codex workers to improve Titan in its shared live repository. Keep a reviewable code change, an inspection guide, independent verdicts and retained script output.

implementer.description: Repair Titan's Bun prerequisite version comparison
implementer.role: Read DEV_RULES.md before editing. Preserve every staged or unrelated change. Work only in your declared files in the shared live repository. Do not commit, push, install dependencies, change configuration, start other agents or run test suites. Implement a focused change and regression cases. The later script step runs verification. Report exact changed paths and known limits.

guide_writer.description: Explain how to inspect this self-editing Titan workflow
guide_writer.role: Read DEV_RULES.md and the installed Titan command help as needed. Write only the declared guide. Preserve every staged and unrelated file. Do not commit, push, install dependencies, change configuration or start other agents. Use plain English and actual supported commands. Distinguish pending results from observed completion.

code_reviewer.description: Independently challenge the runtime comparison change
code_reviewer.role: Read the implementation and shared case tables. Seek concrete counterexamples against the task criteria. Remain read-only. Do not run test suites because the controller owns the later script verification. Return a precise refutation for a defect or a survived verdict with the inspection actually performed.

guide_reviewer.role: Read the guide and compare its commands with Titan's current CLI definitions. Remain read-only and do not run test suites. Refute unsupported commands, invented completion claims or an omitted way to inspect steps and changes. Otherwise report the actual checks performed.
